facts.fact: Restates F127: the fallback route was drawn by Varun in his neat hand on a single copy at Rohan's direction, with Rohan holding the ruler. Rohan also named the cut aloud to Meera on the second night. Rohan rules Meera out as the seller because she has been tied to him every hour since.
Varun has been buried under the gully for about nine days.
